Dear Students - register in KP


Dear Ma'am,

About AB InBev GCC India
Set up in Bengaluru in 2014, AB InBev GCC is a strategic partner to
Anheuser-Busch InBev, the world's largest brewer. It uses data, analytics
and technology to power global functions like Finance, Operations,
Commercial and People.

Role: Senior Analyst – GBS Commercial (Band VIII)

GBS Commercial supports AB InBev's sales and marketing teams across global
markets. Depending on business need, you'd work in one of these areas:
• Sales Intelligence: route-to-market strategy, retailer coverage and
routing
• Demand Planning: sales forecasting for global markets
• Category Management: portfolio and shelf insights for beer and
non-alcoholic brands with key retail accounts
• Marketing & Consumer Insights: digital campaign performance and consumer
listening
You'll analyse sales, retailer and consumer data, build dashboards and
reports, and turn insights into clear recommendations for market teams.

We're looking for: strong commercial sense, comfort working with data
(Excel is a must; Power BI or SQL is a plus), and clear communication with
global stakeholders.

Location - Bengaluru (Mahadevapura)
